intro: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha is a sacred tauren pilgrimage undertaken on Red Cloud Mesa to honor the sun and moon as the celestial eyes of the Earthmother. By carrying fragile, smoldering incense to an elevated shrine in the southeastern hills, travelers show respect to the heavenly lights that bring warmth, life, and direction to the plains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.
We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.

If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.

clips.title: Completion
paras: As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.
